name: tier3-two-crop-v1
description: 18/09/2026, Dean's question: is Tier 3 unbought because of the CARD COUNT or the OWN-CROP requirement? This arm holds the price at FOUR cards and halves the crop requirement: every Tier 3 goes from 3 own crop + 1 any to 2 own crop + 2 any. Nothing else moves. A typical hand is 3.2 cards, so 'hold three of one crop' is the suspect; if that is right this arm alone revives the layer WITHOUT making it cheaper, which is the answer to 'would it break the game'. Read: build-when-held on the fifteen Tier 3 rows of --full-funnel, then crop win rates, median game length and the own-crop build share (87.3% shipped - this arm should pull it DOWN).
